audit.notes: Perfect match for a standard b-roll library. Simply start with an intro shot answering the question hook ('If you don't party how do you have fun?'), followed by rapid 0.5s-1.0s cuts of everyday activities (climbing gym, working on laptop, coffee, reading, walking in NYC, hanging out with friends).
audit.summary: A fast-paced montage answering the common question 'if you don't party how do you have fun?' by highlighting wholesome, productive, and fulfilling lifestyle alternatives through short text overlays on b-roll.
